original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯法院判处奥贡州学生14年监禁，罪名是诈骗
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 拉各斯Ikeja特别犯罪法院判处27岁的联邦农业大学本科生David Ugboko14年监禁，其通过庞氏骗局诈骗投资者2750万奈拉。法官认定其犯有共谋、以虚假借口获取钱财及保留犯罪所得等10项罪名。EFCC在庭审中称调查显示其诈骗超过500名投资者逾10亿奈拉，并指控其将资金挪作个人用途。

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯法院判处27岁大学生David Ugboko14年监禁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Justice Rahman Oshodi of the Ikeja Special Offences Court has sentenced a 27-year-old undergraduate ... David Ugboko, to 14 years’ imprisonment

key_facts.fact: 其因庞氏骗局诈骗投资者2750万奈拉被定罪
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: for defrauding investors through a Ponzi scheme of N27.5m

key_facts.fact: 法官认定其犯有共谋、以虚假借口获取钱财及保留犯罪所得等10项罪名
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: finding Ugboko guilty of 10 counts bordering on conspiracy, obtaining money by false pretence and retention of proceeds of crime

key_facts.fact: EFCC称调查显示其诈骗超过500名投资者逾10亿奈拉
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ugboko defrauded more than 500 investors of over N1bn through the scheme

key_facts.fact: EFCC指控其将资金挪作个人用途，包括购买汽车和建造住宅
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the EFCC alleged that he diverted the funds for personal use, including purchasing a 2006 Mercedes-Benz and commencing the construction of a four-bedroom duplex in Ibadan

uncertainties: 诈骗逾500名投资者、涉案逾10亿奈拉及资金挪用等细节为EFCC在庭审中的指控表述，尚未见独立来源交叉验证
